mapper.insert: insert into messages(msg_id, sender_id, receiver_id, msg_type, content, file_url, file_size, send_time, is_recalled) values(#{msgId}, #{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{msgType}, #{content}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileSize}, #{sendTime}, 0)
mapper.select: select * from messages where msg_id = #{msgId} limit 1
select count(*) from messages where (sender_id = #{myId} and receiver_id = #{peerId}) or (sender_id = #{peerId} and receiver_id = #{myId})
select * from messages where (sender_id = #{myId} and receiver_id = #{peerId}) or (sender_id = #{peerId} and receiver_id = #{myId}) order by send_time desc, id desc limit #{offset}, #{size}

select * from messages where id in ( select max(id) from ( select id, case when sender_id = #{myId} then receiver_id else sender_id end as peer_id from messages where (sender_id = #{myId} or receiver_id = #{myId}) and receiver_id <> 'ALL' ) t group by peer_id ) order by send_time desc, id desc;

select sender_id as peerId, count(*) as unreadCount from messages where receiver_id = #{myId} and send_time > ifnull( (select last_read_time from read_state where user_id = #{myId} and peer_id = sender_id), '1970-01-01 00:00:00') group by sender_id
mapper.insert: insert into read_state(user_id, peer_id, last_read_time) values(#{myId}, #{peerId}, now()) on duplicate key update last_read_time = now()
